name: Weighted Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with hands just outside shoulder width and have a partner position and steady the plate across your upper back.
Brace your abs and glutes so your body forms a rigid straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows at roughly 45 degrees from your torso to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms completely while keeping the plate balanced on your upper back.
tips: Place the plate over your upper back rather than your lower back to protect your spine.
Have your partner remove the plate before you leave the plank.
